evals.prompt: Rename the selected event registration to 'Renamed Webhook' without changing its webhook URL or events. Show the proposed change only; do not apply it.
evals.expected_output: Proposes patch_event_registration with one replace operation on /name and value Renamed Webhook, not update_event_registration. Leaves webhook_url, events_of_interest, delivery_type and enabled unchanged. Does not invent a registration ID or execute the patch.
